name: hub
description: One-click: open a Claude Code session as a new terminal in the current VS Code window.

commands.title: ccm: New Claude session in a terminal
ccm: End of day — backup & close ALL sessions
ccm: Copy terminal selection (fixes reversed Hebrew)
ccm: Open the floating file browser

ccmHub.projectsRoot.markdownDescription: Folder whose immediate subdirectories are listed by the `Alt+O` project picker.

ccmHub.claudeCommand.markdownDescription: Command run in the new terminal after it is opened in the chosen folder.

ccmHub.guardTerminalClose.markdownDescription: Protect terminals from being closed by accident. Sets `#terminal.integrated.confirmOnKill#` to `always` (one terminal) and `#window.confirmBeforeClose#` to `always` (the whole window's X) — each only if you have not set it yourself — and offers to restore a Claude session you killed. While the window guard is `always`, a redundant `#terminal.integrated.confirmOnExit#: always` is removed so one close asks one question, not two. `Alt+Q` asks *backup / close / keep* regardless of this setting.

ccmHub.browser.enterRuns.markdownDescription: In the `Alt+E` file browser, make **Enter** *run* a file that has a known runner instead of opening it in the editor. Off by default so Enter is always safe; the ▶ button on the row, `F5` and `Ctrl+Enter` run a file either way.

ccmHub.browser.showHidden.markdownDescription: Start the `Alt+E` file browser with dot-files and dot-folders visible. `Ctrl+H` toggles it for the current session regardless.

ccmHub.browser.agents.markdownDescription: Extra coding agents for the browser's *סוכן AI* submenu, or overrides for the built-in ones (`claude`, `codex`, `gemini`, `copilot`, `cursor`, `opencode`, `qwen`, `aider`). Each entry is `{ "id", "label", "command", "bin", "glyph", "pkg" }` — `bin` is the executable looked for on PATH (defaults to the first word of `command`), and `pkg` is the npm package offered when it is missing. An entry whose `id` matches a built-in is merged over it.

ccmHub.fixRtlCopy.markdownDescription: Claude Code writes Hebrew to the terminal in visual (reversed) order so it *looks* right, which makes a plain copy paste backwards. When on, `Ctrl+C` on a terminal selection (and the voice probe) copies and then converts the clipboard back to logical order. The terminal's right-click copy always stays raw.

ccmHub.ensureAutoSave.markdownDescription: Fill `#files.autoSave#` with `afterDelay` when you have no value of your own, so edits you type while Claude is working (e.g. in the project's `-TASKS.md`) reach the disk continuously and can never collide with Claude's writes in an Overwrite dialog. Set your own `files.autoSave` (any value, including `off`) and this never touches it.
